capability.title: Capability narratives shaped for AI product engineering
capability.description: This resume intentionally shifts emphasis away from a long historical record and toward the systems I am increasingly well positioned to build next. The throughline is clear: research, tools, evaluation, and product experience are converging in my recent work.

cards.title: Agent Systems, Context, and Harness Engineering
cards.copy: I have been experimenting with role-based workflows built from Ollama, LangGraph, PraisonAI, MCP, function calling, semantic routing, and explicit execution controls. The goal is not a generic chatbot. It is a useful system that can connect documents, code, search, and execution handlers while remaining inspectable. In personal open-source work I built jeo-code (a Bun-based coding-agent harness/CLI framework with a uniform multi-provider tool loop, anchored-edit integrity, and a verify-before-done loop), jeo-skills (a cross-platform agent-skills catalog for harness engineering), and jeo-claw (a Discord-controlled, dual-runtime agentic repo-update agent).

cards.title: Multimodal QA & Computer Vision
cards.copy: Through image-based AutoQA, OCR, template matching, DETR/YOLO testing, and VLM-based bug-reporting research, I have been working on the harder product question: how visual signals become usable QA workflows inside a team.

cards.title: Retrieval, Planning, and Product Interfaces
cards.copy: I have built prototypes such as resume analysis, a game design assistant, coding and web-search agents, and bilingual portfolio surfaces using LlamaIndex, ColBERT, Qdrant, and task planning. I am comfortable turning retrieval and structured planning into product-facing experiences.

cards.title: Delivery Constraints, Wellness, and AI-Native Surfaces
cards.copy: I have explored TinyLlama, DeepSeek-R1-Distill, PEFT/LoRA, ONNX, Flutter, and WebSocket-based system design while also extending my interest toward wellness AI and robotics. I think in terms of deployment shape, product surface, and adoption friction, not just model choice.

career.title: A growth path that bridges research and product systems
career.description: Rather than listing every project in full, this section shows how the current AI product engineering profile was built: from production game AI, to pipeline automation, to multimodal and agentic product work.

items.title: AI Product Developer (Team Member)
items.copy: I design and ship end-to-end AI products — including two Firebase- and Genkit-based internal SaaS platforms (SAGA and Millie) — built on multimodal-embedding RAG systems and agentic AI workflows, and I help establish the AI-native collaboration standards used by internal product teams.
bullets: Built SAGA (Firebase App Hosting + Genkit), a game-studio "AI brain" — a RAG search engine over game design docs using RAG-Fusion, CRAG, hybrid search, Cross-Encoder reranking, and a Grounding-Guardian generation pattern; indexed 594 documents / 1,563 vectors across 15 games (3-week build, Feb 2026)

Built Millie (Firebase App Hosting), a per-user RAG assistant plus a Slack-bot-driven, local-LLM "ClawTeam" autonomous-agent system, with an admin control hub for knowledge sources (Notion/Drive/Calendar), credentials, agent assignment, and LLM call-quality monitoring (4-week build, late Mar 2026)
Designed and deployed multimodal embedding RAG pipelines to improve internal search and knowledge utilization
Built retrieval-centric AI agent workflows and operationalized them for production use
Operated and continuously updated on-premise AI products to maintain service stability and model performance
Led R&D on agentic AI and standardized AI-native collaboration processes across teams
Developed AI productivity tooling to improve game development pipeline throughput
Implemented ML/DL components with Python and PyTorch, including CV and RL-oriented R&D tracks
items.impact: Owned internal AI products from concept to operation — shipping two Firebase/Genkit SaaS platforms (SAGA, Millie) in weeks — while improving reliability, discoverability, and team-level execution speed.

items.title: AI Manager, SmartHome Tech
items.copy: In the smart-home domain, I established AI feature compliance frameworks, tracked and shared Vision/LLM trends for NAMUHx Airsolution, and concurrently delivered monitoring web frontend capabilities.
bullets: Established AI feature compliance standards and prepared technical adoption plans for open-ecosystem integration
Analyzed emerging CV/LLM trends and published internal AI tech letters for cross-team alignment
Owned collaboration tasks for TTS and STT modules
Planned and operated developer ecosystem initiatives, including onboarding and lock-in strategies for PyTorch-based AI/ML/DL pipelines
Managed Git-based collaboration processes for developer operations
Developed operations-monitoring web frontend for real-time device status visibility
items.impact: Built governance + execution foundations that connected AI compliance, technical communication, and practical product operations in a smart-home environment.

items.title: Connecting multimodal QA, agent workflows, and on-device AI into product structures
items.copy: My recent work has centered on AutoQA tooling, VLM-based bug reporting, agentic workflows, RAG assistants, and lightweight chatbot systems. The recurring theme is the final twenty percent that turns a research concept into a working system.
bullets: VLM-based error-detection research grounded in VideoGameQA Bench
Role-based multi-agent workflow experiments with Ollama, LangGraph, PraisonAI, and MCP
Applied assistant prototypes using LlamaIndex, GPT-4o mini, ColBERT, and Qdrant
items.impact: My strength here is not knowing the newest model names. It is designing systems where tool use, instructions, evaluation, and user experience reinforce one another.

items.title: Built game AI, generative systems, and digital human pipelines in real production contexts
items.copy: I worked on match-3 difficulty evaluation agents, cellular automata and GAN-based level generation, Flask-based testing tools, 4D facial scan and digital human pipelines, and calibration automation. These were not abstract research exercises. They were workflow and cost problems inside real teams.
bullets: MCTS-based difficulty evaluation agents and simulation logic
Procedural content generation connected to testing and web-based tooling
4D scan low-poly and post-processing pipelines plus robotics-driven automation
items.impact: This is the foundation for how I think today: high-cost workflows need reliable automation, usable interfaces, and deployment discipline.

items.title: Started with reinforcement learning prototypes and internal product tooling
items.copy: I tested TensorFlow-based reinforcement learning agents in game environments, connected Unity and Python through socket-based architectures, and built internal collaboration tools. This was where I first got used to working at the seam between models and product systems.
bullets: DQN-based reinforcement learning prototypes applied to real game contexts
In-house issue-tracking and collaboration tooling
Hands-on work across front-end, back-end, database, and maintenance
items.impact: I still operate more like an end-to-end builder than a model-only specialist.

working.title: My persona is also my product philosophy
working.description: This framework has been consistent across my blog, research, and product work. Strong AI products do not come from bigger models alone. They come from asking the right question, retrieving the right context, and shaping the result into something people can actually use.

principles.title: Curiosity
principles.copy: I do not start with what the model can do. I start with where the user or team gets blocked. That shift helps me turn ambiguous technical ideas into product questions.

principles.title: Retrieve
principles.copy: I look across papers, benchmarks, logs, existing workflows, and tool interfaces. That is where it becomes obvious why current agent systems are increasingly defined by tools, context, evaluation, and guardrails.

principles.title: Innovation
principles.copy: I always want the work to converge into something operational: a usable interface, a realistic workflow, a hybrid deployment path, or a structure a team can keep improving.

next.title: I want to be judged by what I can build next
next.quote: I am not trying to stay someone who understands research. I am actively growing into the kind of AI product engineer who can connect research to tools, evaluation, interface design, and operational delivery.
next.note: The next step I want to go deeper on is productizing multimodal QA, agent UX, eval-driven delivery, open-protocol-based tool interoperability, and AI-native experiences around wellness and robotics. I create the most value on teams where AI needs to support complex workflows safely, clearly, and pragmatically.
next.calloutCopy: A research-grounded builder with game AI production depth, now shipping toward agentic, multimodal, and product-oriented AI systems.

working.title: 제가 일하는 방식은 곧 제품 철학입니다
working.description: 이 프레임은 블로그, 연구, 제품 작업 전반에서 일관되게 유지해 온 원칙입니다. 좋은 AI 제품은 더 큰 모델만으로 나오지 않고, 올바른 질문과 맥락 회수, 그리고 실제 사용 가능한 형태로의 수렴에서 나옵니다.

principles.title: Curiosity
principles.copy: 저는 모델이 무엇을 할 수 있는지보다 사용자가 어디에서 막히는지를 먼저 봅니다. 그 전환이 모호한 기술 아이디어를 제품 질문으로 바꿔 줍니다.

principles.title: Retrieve
principles.copy: 논문, 벤치마크, 로그, 기존 workflow, tool interface를 함께 봅니다. 이 단계에서 왜 최근 agent system이 tools, context, evaluation, guardrails 중심으로 이동하는지가 분명해집니다.

principles.title: Innovation
principles.copy: 결국에는 운영 가능한 형태로 수렴시키고 싶습니다. usable interface, realistic workflow, hybrid deployment path, 팀이 계속 개선할 수 있는 구조를 만드는 쪽으로 마무리합니다.

next.title: 앞으로 무엇을 더 잘 만들 수 있는지로 평가받고 싶습니다
next.quote: 저는 연구를 이해하는 사람에 머물기보다, 연구를 도구, 평가, 인터페이스 설계, 운영 가능한 전달 구조로 연결하는 AI product engineer로 계속 성장하고 있습니다.
next.note: 다음 단계에서는 멀티모달 QA, agent UX, eval-driven delivery, open protocol 기반 tool interoperability, wellness/robotics 주변의 AI-native 경험을 더 깊게 제품화하고 싶습니다. AI가 복잡한 workflow를 안전하고 명확하게 보조해야 하는 팀에서 가장 큰 가치를 냅니다.
next.calloutCopy: 게임 AI production 경험을 기반으로, agentic, multimodal, product-oriented AI systems를 실제 제품으로 연결하고 있는 연구 기반 빌더입니다.
